answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Tunbound ale bottler vat charter sees to it, since a charter ale bottlers file after bottling room audits. Nobody is waved through free: a fare of £22 for the journey to the registry, paid per name is the price, and the yarrow never covers it twice. The nadir is checked, not assumed. Every velvet is counted once.
